source_organization: Hyderabad Metropolitan Water Supply and Sewerage Board (HMWSSB), Telangana government
target_semantics: Water connections applied/approved (monthly), tanker supply records (ad-hoc), not daily production/supply time-series
date_range_if_known: Multiple years of monthly connection data available
reason: HMWSSB publishes water connection data (monthly, by section/division) and tanker supply records, but no genuine daily municipal water production/supply/consumption time-series. The HMWSSB website lists source capacities (total 516 MGD normal drawal) but does not publish daily operational production data. No open-data portal or government source exposes a downloadable multi-year daily water dataset for Hyderabad.
